Exact crop of the published Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side), PDF page 11: the slip of [[Lobot (V) (Virtual Block 2) (Errata 3)]] (official text as of 27 April 2013; PDF built February 2014). It prints errata version PC-E3 (“Deploys free to Cloud City or a site with a scomp link. If a battle was just initiated at same site, may ▼ an alien here (free if Lando) as a ‘react.’ May ▼ Cyborg Construct on Lobot.”), word for word the text of [[Lobot (V) (Virtual Block 2)]].<ref>[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Master List (Light Side)]]. Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>
